name: Volumetric Non-Overlapping Invariance

name: Vertical Air-Rights Ceiling Constraint
standard: Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) Obstacle Limitation

name: Subsurface Utility Separation Buffer
enforcement: Minimum 3.0-meter clearance envelope around high-pressure gas/water pipelines
